text:
ginger-arch: ok team — kicking off a short thread to align on the tenant sharding playbook idea and what we treat as MVP vs full scope. want quick votes + blockers.
ben-pm: high level ask from sales: several enterprise customers require per-tenant isolation + EU-only residency. they also want predictable tail latency.
erin-eng: two parallel levers: 1) routing policy matrix (static mapping + exception rules) 2) runtime slices (shards) with resource caps. MVP should be the matrix + static shard assignments.
carmen-se: customer ask: support BYOK KMS per-tenant and predictable throughput (i.e., reserved capacity). that pushes private/dedicated integration earlier.
ginger-arch: agreed. propose MVP: static tenant -> shard binding, per-shard resource caps, routing policy enforcement layer, basic metrics and alerting. no autoscaling yet.
frank-sre: launch criteria we should gate on: p95 inference latency within 1.5x of baseline for dedicated tenants, no cross-tenant cache leakage, and canary rollback path tested. also ops runbooks for tenant quarantine.\er in-eng: typo ^^ erin-eng.
erin-eng: ha, fixed. + on metrics: need token-level cost attribution and per-tenant p50/p95/p99 for both latency and token spend.
ben-pm: timeline suggestion: design doc and API contract in 3w, infra prototype 6w, pilot with 2 customers 10w, GA in next quarter if pilot OK. open to negotiation.
carmen-se: pilot customers need feature flags to disable routing changes and a no-downtime migration path. we should surface a migration checklist for their engineers.
ginger-arch: migration knobs: 1) header-based routing override 2) sticky affinity TTL 3) shadow traffic to new shard. include a small CLI for ops to move tenants.
frank-sre: also require automated fallback: if shard overloaded, route to compatible model variant in hosted pool with rate limit. SLA must state fallback may increase latency.
erin-eng: config snippet we sketched yesterday: 
```
routing_policy:
  - tenant_pattern: "^acct-.*-eu$"
    shard: shard-eu-1
    residency: eu_only
    fallback: hosted-small
    affinity_ttl: 24h
```
that plus RBAC for who can change mapping.
ben-pm: acceptance criteria (short): 1) can assign tenant to shard via API 2) p95 < 120ms on pilot tenants 3) no cross-tenant KV cache reads 4) runbook validated in staging.
carmen-se: security ask: support per-tenant audit logs and KMS key binding at GA. mark as blocker for GA but optional for pilot.
ginger-arch: dependency list: runtime KV namespacing, per-tenant billing tags, console UI for mapping, infra autoscaler (for future), KMS integration. owners: eng-runtime (runtime), eng-platform (routing + console), eng-sre (runbooks).
frank-sre: operational checklist for pilot: chaos test (network partition), tenant surge test, slow-model-injection. dev-bot: deploy scheduled: staging-rollout-1758881000 (reaction: :white_check_mark:).
erin-eng: risk log: 1) noisy neighbor if caps mis-set 2) rollout complexity for millions of small tenants 3) data residency verification across regions. mitigation: caps, gradual rollout, residency verification jobs.
ginger-arch: negotiation note: customers asked for dynamic autoscale per-tenant — we push that to v1 to avoid infra scope creep. but we offer reserved capacity lanes for key customers in MVP.
ben-pm: next steps: I'll draft a PRD with MVP vs v1 scope and expected metrics. erin/carmen/frank please add acceptance tests and blockers into the PRD by EOW.
carmen-se: adding customer migration checklist now, will link in PRD.
erin-eng: I'll drop the proto API in github and tag owners.
frank-sre: I will prepare the runbook template and the chaos test plan.
ginger-arch: thanks — good sync. if no objections, we lock MVP scope tomorrow and start design doc. :rocket:
